blocks.text: Models aise tools hain jo complex masail ko saada kar ke samjhate hain. Yeh bohat se shobon (fields) mein dastiyab data ki bunyad par pesh-goi aur faisle karne ke liye istemal hote hain. Aam misalein: mausam ki pesh-goi (weather forecasting), maali andaze (financial predictions) aur scientific research.

Mausam ki pesh-goi mein models aane wale mausam ka andaza lagate hain. Meteorologists (mausam ke mahireen) temperature, humidity (nami) aur hawa ki raftar (wind speed) ka data jama karte hain, phir models se is data ka jaiza le kar mausam batate hain.

Maali duniya mein bhi models bohat aham hain. Banks aur companies inhein maeeshat ke rujhan (economic trends), stock prices aur customers ke rawayye (behavior) ka andaza lagane ke liye istemal karti hain.

Scientific research mein models scientists ko theories jaanchne, naye khayalat dekhne aur data ki bunyad par pesh-goi karne mein madad dete hain. Machine Learning (ML) aur Artificial Intelligence (AI) ki taraqqi se models bohat zyada data ka jaiza lene mein aur bhi taqatwar aur durust ho gaye hain.

blocks.prompt: Statistical models ka asal duniya ka istemal kaunsa hai: gharon ki qeematon ki pesh-goi, social media posts banana, websites design karna ya essays likhna? (MCQ 6) Aisa masla bataiye jahan statistical model lag sakta hai. (Short question 6)
blocks.explanation: (a) gharon ki qeematon ki pesh-goi. Ek aur misal: customers ki tadaad se phal ke stall ki rozana kamai ka andaza (topic 5.4.1.2), ya mausam ke data se kisan ke liye bone ka behtareen waqt.

items: Models ke istemal: mausam ki pesh-goi, maaliyat aur scientific research (ML aur AI se aur taqatwar).
